title: Idhu Kathirvelan Kadhal
overview: Kathir a Madurai lad goes to Coimbatore with a purpose and very soon flips for the charms of a beautiful Pavithra who is their neighbor. But Pavithra is already in love with her friend Gautham who is 'not a nice guy'. Kathir who was looking out for his friend at college Mayil bumps into suddenly and he turns love advisor for Kathir.
